cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(CashuDevKit)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# The Android C++ library: our handwritten bridge plus the JNI entrypoint.
add_library(CashuDevKit SHARED
  ../cpp/HybridOutputDataCreator.cpp
  src/main/cpp/cpp-adapter.cpp
)

# Pull in everything Nitrogen generated: the spec sources, the autolinking
# registration (CashuDevKitOnLoad.cpp), the generated include dirs, and the
# fbjni / ReactAndroid / NitroModules links. This file is authoritative and
# regenerated by `npm run codegen`.
include(${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../nitrogen/generated/android/CashuDevKit+autolinking.cmake)

target_include_directories(CashuDevKit PRIVATE ../cpp)

# Link the prebuilt cdk_nitro Rust library. build-android.sh copies
# libcdk_nitro.so into src/main/jniLibs/<abi>/.
find_library(CDK_NITRO cdk_nitro PATHS
  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/main/jniLibs/${ANDROID_ABI}
)
if(CDK_NITRO)
  target_link_libraries(CashuDevKit ${CDK_NITRO})
else()
  message(WARNING "libcdk_nitro.so not found for ${ANDROID_ABI} - run rust/build-android.sh")
endif()
